# KS Design Studio (Pune, India)
> Premier Luxury Turnkey Interior Designers & Architectural Atelier in Pune, Maharashtra.

## Overview
KS Design Studio is an A-grade architectural interior design firm based in Wakad, Pune, specializing in bespoke luxury residential (2 BHK, 3 BHK, 4 BHK, Penthouses, Villas) and commercial turnkey interior executions across Pune's prime micro-markets including Baner, Wakad, Kharadi, Koregaon Park, Aundh, Kothrud, and Bavdhan.

## Key Facts & Credentials
- **Location**: 623, Vision One Mall, Bhumkar Chowk, Wakad, Pune, Maharashtra 411057
- **Phone**: +91 70203 77693
- **Email**: contact@ksdesignstudio.in
- **Website**: https://ksdesignstudio.in
- **Principal Architect**: Komal Sharma (Alumni: Sir J.J. College of Architecture)
- **Specializations**: Turnkey Execution, Modular Kitchens, Living Room Sanctuaries, Master Bedroom Suites, Smart Automation, Vastu Compliance, Acoustic & Spatial Engineering.

## Core Services
- Turnkey Residential Interiors (2 BHK, 3 BHK, 4 BHK, Penthouses, Villas)
- Commercial & Executive Studio Interiors
- Modular Kitchen Architecture & Wardrobe Systems
- Precision Spatial Auditing & Vastu-Compliant Layout Planning
- 3D Interactive Walkthroughs & Material Sourcing
- Real-Time Interior Cost Estimation
